title: ISRO launch missions, cumulative
definition: Cumulative count of ISRO launch vehicle missions flown since the SLV programme began in 1979.
notes: The 100th mission was reached in January 2025, 46 years after the first launch.
Cadence, not total, is the real story: 43 missions in the 35 years to 2009, then 91 missions in the 17 years to 2026.

title: ISRO launch cadence by era
definition: Average launch missions per year across two distinct eras of the Indian space programme.
notes: A roughly 4x increase in launch tempo. Still an order of magnitude below China (60+ orbital launches a year) and SpaceX alone.

title: ISRO missions by launch vehicle
definition: Count of missions flown by each Indian launch vehicle family.
notes: PSLV has carried roughly every second ISRO satellite. That dependence is a single-point risk, underlined by third-stage failures on PSLV-C61 (May 2025) and PSLV-C62 (January 2026).

title: Satellites on a single launch
definition: Largest number of satellites placed in orbit by India on one launch vehicle.
notes: The 2017 PSLV-C37 record of 104 satellites stood as a world record until surpassed by SpaceX Transporter missions.
